newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: SLOVENIAN BANK NKBM H1 PRETAX SLUMPS 25 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVENIAN BANK NKBM H1 PRETAX SLUMPS 25 PCT.

text.p: Slovenia's third largest bank Nova Kreditna Banka (NKBM) said on Tuesday pre-tax profit for the first six months fell to 1.5 billion tolars from two billion in the same period last year.

Total assets climbed to 213.7 billion tolars ($1.25 billion) from 187.5 billion. The unlisted NKBM, which is expected to be privatised next year, said assets had increased 8.4 percent since the begining of the year.
NKBM has a market share of 11.5 percent. Slovenia has a total of 28 banks, most of which are in private hands. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
